title: The 5-Email Welcome Flow: If I started over, I'd fix welcome sequence first
caption:
If I started over, I'd fix welcome sequence first

The old way vs. what actually works now:
1️⃣ Deliver in 60 seconds — Magnet plus one quick win. Speed is the first impression.
2️⃣ Tell the one story — Why you do this and who it's for. People buy people, then products.
3️⃣ Share the biggest mistake — The thing they're doing wrong right now — fix it for free, no pitch.
4️⃣ Make one soft pitch — One offer, one link. The rest of the flow keeps giving.
